captions.detailed: A compact, palm-sized camcorder designed in a solid black plastic material. It features a main rectangular body with rounded vertical edges, a cylindrical lens barrel extending from the front, a rounded handgrip on the side, and a flip-out rectangular side monitor attached via a small hinge block. The top of the body contains a distinct circular mode dial. The side monitor is designed to rotate outward on a vertical hinge, the lens ring rotates continuously around the barrel axis, and the top mode dial rotates continuously on its center axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a palm-sized black camcorder. The design must include a rounded main body, a front lens barrel, a side handgrip, a top mode dial, and a flip-out side monitor connected with a visible hinge. Ensure the side monitor is articulated to swing out, and both the lens ring and top dial are set up for continuous rotation.
captions.factory: The camcorder is built by first creating a rounded rectangular extrusion for the main body shell. A cylinder is combined with a smaller hollow cylinder to form the lens barrel, and a separate cylindrical ring is added for the rotating lens ring. The side grip is constructed from a half-cylinder with a small rectangular strap block. The top dial is modeled as a small knurled cylinder placed on a thin rectangular base plate. Finally, the side monitor is created from a thin box attached to a hinge block, with joints defined to allow the monitor to rotate outward and the lens ring/top dial to rotate continuously.
